summary: Configured the routed Kubernetes cluster. node2, node3, and node4 are Ready, with Kubernetes traffic on lan-a/lan-b via node1.
actions_performed: Persisted VyOS LAN routing and forwarding.
Persisted Ubuntu LAN routes, sysctls, modules, containerd, kubelet, and LAN node addresses.
Initialized Kubernetes 1.34.11 on node2 and joined node3/node4.
Installed Flannel VXLAN bound to enp8s0.
Verified cross-LAN pod-to-pod, CoreDNS, ClusterIP, and API connectivity.
